title: Dispersion stripes
summary: One triangle-wave stripe evaluated per channel with red `+.06` / blue `−.05` phase shifts, the phase a rotated ramp bent by a radial bump and 2D simplex and drifted on the shared ticker while on screen; coverage re-thresholded as `(g − .5) / max(fwidth(g) × 4, 1e-5) + .5` so every edge is a few-pixel ramp and a flat `g` cannot blow open; inline ACES, gamma and interleaved-gradient-noise dither with no render target, inside a rounded slab; one still frame under reduced motion and static
variants: three.js ShaderMaterial on a fullscreen triangle
stripes masked by a runtime shape texture instead of the slab distance
